title: •Trade Federation Tactics
caption: •Trade Federation Tactics (V)
game_text: USED: For remainder of turn, if your starship is about to be hit (or lost), that action may instead affect your character aboard that starship. LOST: If your {episode1} character is about to be hit (or lost), that action instead affects your other {episode1} character present.
lore: Organizations as wealthy as the Trade Federation can afford large amounts of military hardware, all purchased under the guise of protecting their commercial interests.

notes: Unique. Banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT (printed base is a Lost Interrupt). Inline black 'EPISODE I' circles (twice) → {episode1} (stub: 'Episode I'). NOTE: on this slip 'LOST:' follows 'starship.' on the SAME line (not on its own line), so the game text has a space, not \n, before LOST:. No margin credits. Lore matches the wiki (checked on the 745 px V11 remake). Copyright '… 2001 DECIPHER INC.' legible on V11. Base scan 350 px. Modern: V11-D-tradefederationtactics.gif (745 px); VB5 (350) also exists, not downloaded. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
